viewer: Hindi-speaking 16-30 year olds who grew up on grandparents' ghost stories
hook: Wo tumhara naam do baar pukaarti hai. Teesri baar mat sunna.
payoff: Three folk signs of a chudail; the last one: she never comes in, you invite her. Who called you twice today?
cta: Apni daadi ka niyam comment karo, best wala agla reel banega.
sources: Common North Indian folklore about the chudail (reversed feet, calling by name, needing an invitation), retold in original words. Code-drawn visuals, Kalpa Labs TTS (Aman), studio-synthesized SFX/BGM. No third-party footage or audio.
